var_base.note: PER-QUESTION identical to the committed ceiling-e2e control on all three arms (78/78 each) — extraction on the reproducible q8_0 stack is fully deterministic; every c2op delta is attributable to the op feature.

mechanism.finding: The op block itself IMPROVES scalar extraction on non-set questions. The damage is concentrated where sets form: the model applies op:'add' to AGGREGATE/COUNT slots and the one-way scalar->set conversion destroys the stated-total scalar the KU benchmark answers count questions with (e.g. 'total species: 32' becomes 'bird species spotted: 27; Northern Flicker (2 members)'). LongMemEval-KU states totals in-conversation and rarely enumerates full memberships, so extraction-driven sets structurally mismatch this question class; a single spurious member-add converts and destroys a good scalar.
followups: conversion guard: member-add targeting a slot whose current scalar is numeric/aggregate parks as contender instead of converting
prompt rule: op never applies to counts/totals/quantities
evaluate extraction-driven sets on membership-ENUMERATING content (LME-V2 trajectories) rather than stated-total chat

decision: Block held again — same posture as the merged option B, now on corrected, fully-attributed grounds. The parse fix ships (required for the MCP tools' future and any op-emitting student; dormant without the block). Product surface unaffected throughout.
